_source: generated by `python -m mccontrol.webexport` from mccontrol/envelope.py, mccontrol/mcc3.py; do not edit

help.1: The message reached the node with nothing in it.
help.2: The message is longer than a node takes (512 bytes).
help.4: The signature is not 128 hex characters long.
help.5: The signature is not valid hex.
help.6: The message is in a format the node does not know. Its firmware may be older than this tool.
help.7: A field is missing from the message, or its expiry is not a number.
help.8: The counter is not a number the node can read.
help.9: The node has already seen a higher counter. Wait a second and send again.
help.10: The envelope expired before the node read it. Check the node's clock and yours.
help.11: The expiry is more than an hour ahead of the node's clock. Check the node's clock and yours.
help.12: The node has no clock yet, so it cannot judge expiry. It will after its first advert.
help.13: The command holds a character the node refuses: a control character, the | separator or broken UTF-8.
help.14: The command is not on the node's allowlist. Only what its firmware admits travels this way.
help.15: The node has no command key provisioned. Set mqtt.cmd.pubkey over serial first.
help.16: The signature did not verify. The node holds a different public key than this one.
help.17: The node's rate limit refused it. Wait a few minutes.
help.18: A command that transmits may not be sent to every node at once.
help.19: The node takes commands over the mesh only while its MQTT link has been down for 15 minutes. Send over MQTT.

help_sv.1: Meddelandet kom fram till noden utan innehåll.
help_sv.2: Meddelandet är längre än en nod tar emot (512 byte).
help_sv.6: Meddelandet har ett format som noden inte känner till. Dess firmware kan vara äldre än det här verktyget.
help_sv.7: Ett fält saknas i meddelandet, eller så är utgångstiden inte ett tal.
help_sv.8: Räknaren är inte ett tal som noden kan läsa.
help_sv.11: Utgångstiden ligger mer än en timme före nodens klocka. Kontrollera nodens klocka och din.
help_sv.13: Kommandot innehåller ett tecken som noden nekar: ett styrtecken, avgränsaren | eller trasig UTF-8.

forward.rule: the status of a forward result. 0: the target's response is inside, with its own result code. 1 is silence, never a refusal. 2 and up: the relay sent nothing

help.0: The relay sent the command and the node answered.
help.1: The relay sent the command and heard no answer in two minutes. This is not a refusal: the node may have run it.
help.2: Relaying is switched off on the relay. Send it: set mqtt.relay own
help.3: The relay got the request too late, or its clock and yours disagree. Nothing was sent.
help.4: The relay has already seen a newer request. Nothing was sent. Send again.
help.5: The relay refused the request, the route or the path. Nothing was sent.
help.6: The relay is waiting for the answer to another command. Nothing was sent. Try again in two minutes.
help.7: The relay has used its hour's budget: 10 commands, of which 2 floods. Nothing was sent.
help.8: The relay has no time yet. Nothing was sent. Try again in a minute.
help.9: The relay could not send right now. Nothing was sent. Try again.

help_sv.0: Reläet skickade kommandot och noden svarade.
help_sv.1: Reläet skickade kommandot och hörde inget svar på två minuter. Det är ingen vägran: noden kan ha kört det.
help_sv.2: Reläfunktionen är avstängd på reläet. Skicka: set mqtt.relay own
help_sv.3: Begäran kom för sent till reläet, eller så går dess klocka och din olika. Inget skickades.
help_sv.4: Reläet har redan sett en nyare begäran. Inget skickades. Skicka igen.
help_sv.5: Reläet nekade begäran, vägen eller sökvägen. Inget skickades.
help_sv.6: Reläet väntar på svaret på ett annat kommando. Inget skickades. Försök igen om två minuter.
help_sv.7: Reläet har använt timmens budget: 10 kommandon, varav 2 flood. Inget skickades.
help_sv.8: Reläet har ingen tid ännu. Inget skickades. Försök igen om en minut.
help_sv.9: Reläet kunde inte sända just nu. Inget skickades. Försök igen.
